reviewSamples.author: Photo of Daniel Villasmil
reviewSamples.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 – Excellent Service and Honest People!

Great experience with Car Doctor! I called toward the end of the day, almost at closing time, because I needed brake service, and they were extremely attentive, polite, and helpful from the start.

They even ordered the parts they thought I might need ahead of time so they could take care of the repair efficiently. What impressed me the most was their honesty: Tomas after inspecting the car, realized the brake discs didn’t need to be replaced, so they returned them instead of charging me for something unnecessary. That says a lot about the integrity of a repair shop.

Excellent customer service, fair and honest work, and very professional. It’s great to find a mechanic you can trust. Definitely 5/5 and highly recommended!

reviewSamples.text: I’ve been going to this car shop for a couple of years and I definitely won’t change my car shop of trust. Totally recommended for anyone who wants quality and fair prices.
